Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Deepak Tijori (born 1961) was born earlier than Harry Piel (born 1892). They misapplied logic by comparing the directors’ ages at their films’ release (35 vs. 56) across vastly different years and inferred “older at release” means “born earlier.” The correct comparison of birth years (1892 vs. 1961) shows Harry Piel was born earlier, so Circus Beely should have been the answer.
